description: One call answers what a destination offers and what's on: counts, a few places, next events and guide topics. It counts offers, seasonality and FAQs too, and names the categories and areas listings, events and offers filter by. Drill in with destination_listings / destination_events only if preview.complete is false.

destination.description: Destination name or slug, e.g. 'Los Cabos'; list_cities names them.
